name: GivePhoto - The Strip The Card Overlaps
description: The full-bleed photograph between the hero and the giving card. A band of its own rather than a background on either neighbour, because the card pulls up over it with a negative margin and needs a real element to sit against. Captured with a real photograph, not a colour block: the whole band is an object-fit cover crop at a clamped height, and a solid stand-in would show the box while proving nothing about how a picture survives it.
